mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a fundamental input to population health status, along with other factors, including social determinants of health."
Service delivery is a fundamental input to population health status, along with other factors, including social determinants of health.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the main provider of tertiary healthcare services and various other health intervention programmes aimed at promoting, protecting and preventing ill health of Nigerians."

The Federal Ministry of Health is the main provider of tertiary healthcare services and various other health intervention programmes aimed at promoting, protecting and preventing ill health of Nigerians.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means there exists a lack of appropriate delivery or implementation methods for the healthcare resources injected into global health."
An implementation bottleneck means there exists a lack of appropriate delivery or implementation methods for the healthcare resources injected into global health.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a health and human rights priority, and action cannot be delayed."
Addressing climate change is a health and human rights priority, and action cannot be delayed.

Gender Inequality Gender inequality is the notion that women and men are not equal.

Quality Technical quality refers to the impact of the health services on the health conditions of a particular population.

Malaria during pregnancy is an important cause of maternal mortality, spontaneous abortions and stillbirths.

Population growth is the difference between birth and mortality rates (excluding migration) and the global population explosion in the last century can be attributed to improvements in health and dropping mortality rates.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are concerned with the allocation of scarce resources between competing demands."
Economists are concerned with the allocation of scarce resources between competing demands.

Operational policies are the rules, regulations, guidelines and administrative norms that governments use to translate national laws and policies into programmes and services.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to issues that directly or indirectly impact on the health of populations and can transcend national boundaries."
Global health refers to issues that directly or indirectly impact on the health of populations and can transcend national boundaries.

Health service-delivery performance means to access and use by those in need; adequate quality of care to produce health benefits; efficient use of scarce resources; and organizations that can learn, adapt, and improve for the future.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the main way to prevent and reduce malaria transmission."
Vector control is the main way to prevent and reduce malaria transmission.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are called neglected because they have been largely wiped out in the developed world and persist only in the poorest, most marginalized communities and conflict zones."
NTDs are called neglected because they have been largely wiped out in the developed world and persist only in the poorest, most marginalized communities and conflict zones.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to biological differences, whereas gender refers to social differences (Vlassoff, 2007)."
Sex refers to biological differences, whereas gender refers to social differences (Vlassoff, 2007).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an integrated aspect of the Global Health- PHS 812 course."
The Global Health Practicum is an integrated aspect of the Global Health- PHS 812 course.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the preferred form of Insecticide-Treated Mosquito Nets (ITNs) for public health programmes."
Long-Lasting Insecticidal Nets (LLINs) are the preferred form of Insecticide-Treated Mosquito Nets (ITNs) for public health programmes.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to long-term statistical shifts of the weather, including changes in the average weather condition or the distribution of weather conditions around the average (i.e. extreme weather events)."

Climate change refers to long-term statistical shifts of the weather, including changes in the average weather condition or the distribution of weather conditions around the average (i.e. extreme weather events).

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the deliberate effort of some individuals to make an institution ineffective by working at cross purposes to its goals thereby eroding public trust in the institution."
Institutional corruption is the deliberate effort of some individuals to make an institution ineffective by working at cross purposes to its goals thereby eroding public trust in the institution.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the continuous assessment component of the course."
The Tutor-Marked Assignment (TMA) is the continuous assessment component of the course.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a major goal of public health."
Reducing health disparities is a major goal of public health.
